acceptance_scope: Independent visual acceptance of both strict side profiles, complete five-view layout, white exterior and dimensional materials. Front/rear and texture limitations remain below.
provenance_note: User-requested side-camera correction of a previously generated sheet, not source-only generation. Ordered generated inputs and the exact prompts required for the retained edit chain are recorded below. Original base sheets are recoverable from Git; unused attempts and intermediate images are not retained in the current repository. Real source photos were reviewed as evidence but were not direct inputs to the selected edit calls.

edit_chain.prompt:
Edit IMAGE 1, the five-view burgundy/cream Godzilla Skyline toy sheet.
IMAGE 2 is a DIFFERENT CAR and is ONLY an approved CAMERA/PROJECTION EXAMPLE. Copy exactly the strict lateral camera of its upper two panels. DO NOT copy that car's design, colors, wheels, wing, graphics or proportions.
The output subject must remain the car in IMAGE 1, same physical casting and exact livery, in all five panels.

Correct the upper two panels of image 1 to match image 2's DEAD-LEVEL ENGINEERING SIDE ELEVATIONS: first nose-right, second nose-left, orthographic, camera horizontal and exactly perpendicular. In image 2 the hood/roof/deck are thin silhouette lines, the wheel faces are circles, wing supports overlap and the nose has no front-face width. Achieve that same camera on the subject. No visible hood/deck TOP, no look down through cabin, no frontal grille/headlamp surfaces. Use the real body shape; do not erase graphics, flatten body height or replace the bumper with a rectangular slab. Retain rounded and sloping nose/bumper contours and real side relief.
Cream-front/burgundy-rear Nissan Skyline JHW90 Godzilla, black six-spoke wheels, distinct cream/burgundy Godzilla cloud/beam livery on each side. Keep normally readable ゴジラ on BOTH sides; do not mirror the Japanese lettering. Tiny Hot Wheels flame text may remain approximate but must not be reversed. Hood stripe and roof claw artwork must disappear from side rows through real camera reprojection, never painting over the artwork. Additionally fix the overhead roof to EXACTLY THREE cream claw slashes (currently four); keep their position and diagonal direction. Keep the burgundy wing, GO-JIRA rear plate and nismo front lip.

Keep the subject's overhead panel and two bottom fascia views, same layout and scale. No borrowed details from image 2. Keep the original subject's natural photographic metal gradients, smooth fine metallic flecks, rounded tire volume, recessed spokes, thick glazing and cabin depth. No vector/sprite style or engraved/paisley/swirled texture. Pure white outside silhouettes, no cast/contact shadows, no floor or halo. Five views, no labels or extra elements.

cross_view_consistency.observation: Main identity and mechanical pose agree; these synthesized projections are not a metrically calibrated camera set.

limitations: Small left-side Hot Wheels lettering is garbled/reversed-looking and must be taken from the real photo for accurate texturing.
Bottom front/rear panels retain elevation and visible upper surfaces; they are approximate fascia references.
Fine lettering, reflections and reconstructed dimensions remain synthetic approximations, not calibrated CAD or an exact albedo map.
True overhead geometry is partly inferred from elevated photographs.
No Tripo reconstruction or numerical camera calibration was performed in this correction task.
